finding: F6C-03; reviews/F2-06-C-capacity-reliability-changeability-alternatives.md; 07-integrations-capacity.md section 6 (R-X24); 05 section 9 adverse row 10, benign column
case: A reservation consumed inside its window, whose lapse occurrence was planned and never became due.
why: The lapse rule binds AT the lapse point and nowhere before it, which is why the occurrence binding accepts `due`, `admitted`, `running`, `completed`, `missed` and `disposed` and refuses only `planned`: a scheduled lapse nobody woke for is not a lapse. The patch hardens the guard by also demanding the account the allowance is drawn against, which every real reservation names, and it must not be refused.
